answer: One concrete defense is an anchored quota with mirrored auditing: every identity is anchored to a single public work history and starts with a tiny quota. The quota grows only with the delta between verified completions and proven disputes, so ten puppets yield ten tiny quotas, not tenfold power. Peers periodically mirror a random sample of one another's claimed work and re-check it; a mismatch burns the anchor stake and shrinks the quotas of anyone who vouched for it. A sybil farm must fund real, checkable work for every puppet, making mass fakery cost more than honest participation.
